name: friday-ai
description: Friday AI skills: branch-aware project context recall plus requirement-to-MR automation through the Friday MCP server. 8 skills (friday / friday-dev / friday-routing / friday-solution / friday-blueprint-stages / friday-code / friday-feishu / friday-memory) covering local branch context recall (progress / PRD / feature list / continue-where-you-left-off), feature-list/PRD-to-repository-routing matrix (target repo incl. monorepo sub-app, landing files, new-vs-modify with evidence, confidence, batched option-based clarification), feature-list-to-technical-solution (new-vs-modify classification, repository confirmation, per-repo + overall plan), standalone blueprint stage runs (requirement spec with ambiguity scoring, three-component repository routing, sandboxed repository research — dry-run proposals with explicit user-approved write-back), repository discovery, GraphRAG analysis, coding plans, containerized execution, MR creation, Feishu work item workflows, and delivery memory. Hooks auto-inject project context per prompt and silently capture session learnings back to Friday. Ships two subagents (friday-plan: drives the async technical-plan orchestration — initiate, relay clarifications, poll — keeping the main context clean; friday-research: read-only cross-repo / delivery-history research returning evidence digests with IDs).
